backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md core multi-window protocol plus Space frozen snapshots

gate1.known_bias: Space candidate snapshots are frozen historical replay copies; forward replacement profiles come from closed 2026 event-state ledger rows, so any helper remains default-off metadata and live Space slots stay zero.

attention_overlay_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least one attention-only event seed and at least one official non-attention event seed

government_contract_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with government_space_contract from an official non-attention source

multi_event_depth.target_definition: official Space ticker with at least two official, non-attention event seed rows

single_event_defense_profile.target_definition: official Space ticker with exactly one official non-attention seed, government_space_contract present, no customer_win, and defense_budget_theme

gate_questions.q1_alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: add an incremental scalar only to Space trend_long signals whose closed 10d forward profile already passes the accepted same-theme replacement-strength bucket.
q2_prior_experiments: exp-20260513-113 accepted cash-positive plus same-theme-positive forward replacement risk at 1.05x.
exp-20260514-002 accepted the same-theme replacement-strength sub-bucket at $500 / 1.05x.
exp-20260513-026 rejected a target-width lifecycle change for an IWM+peer trend state.
exp-20260511-023 found broad remaining trend risk was underpowered; this is narrower and forward-replacement conditioned.
gate_questions.q3_single_causal_variable: Only the additional trend-strength risk scalar changes; accepted exp-002 stack and all entries/exits/ranking/targets stay fixed.
gate_questions.q4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, at least two EV-improved windows, no EV-regressed window, max drawdown damage <= 0.5pp, survival >= 5%, >=50 aggregate trades, and real adjusted signals.

hypothesis: On top of accepted exp-20260514-002, the forward same-theme replacement-strength Space edge may be stronger for trend_long continuation than for breakouts. A single extra trend-only scalar tests whether replacement-strength allocation should become more strategy-aware without changing the Space pool, rankings, targets, stops, LLM/news, or live slots.
known_risks: The Space sleeve remains default-off and historical Space snapshots are frozen research copies.
Forward replacement profiles are closed 2026 outcomes and should not be treated as proof for live routing.
The trend-only interaction is same-sample and should stay conservative even if accepted.
next_evidence_needed: Promote only as shared default-off Space metadata/helper; keep live Space slots at zero until forward replacement evidence broadens.

locked_variables: all prior accepted Space risk helpers

single_causal_variable: extra risk scalar for trend_long signals in the accepted forward same-theme replacement-strength bucket
variants: <stripped 153KB oversized field; full value retained in the experiment artifact>
why_not_other_changes: LLM soft-ranking remains label-thin; noisy ticker expansion and mature satcom breadth have failed; recent forward event-depth replay produced no PnL movement. This tests a strategy-aware replacement-strength allocation state instead.
